displayName: RPG Runner - reward pending over 15 minutes

documentation.content: The settlement-repair scan found retryable rewards pending longer than 15 minutes. Inspect the run session and delivery logs, then use the bounded repair path; do not edit wallet or grant data manually.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: jsonPayload.message="run_settlement" AND jsonPayload.event="settlement_repair_scan" AND jsonPayload.retryablePendingCount>0 AND jsonPayload.oldestRetryableAgeMs>=900000
